label: sy1
ar:
قاطع صوت الباب اجتماع النادي فجأة، فالتفتت مونيكا
وسايوري نحو مصدره.
en: The club meeting is suddenly interrupted by the sound of the door, causing Monika and Sayori to turn their heads.

label: sy1
ar: انفتح الباب قليلا ثمّ توقّف. أطلّ وجه من خلفه.
en: The door opens halfway, then stops. A face peeks inside.

label: sy1
en: A face that seems familiar.

label: sy1
ar: اتسعت عينا سايوري حين تذكرت من تكون تلك الفتاة.
en: Sayori's eyes widen, recognizing the girl.

label: sy1
ar: وحرّكت شفتيها بتلميح لا يخفى على مونيكا.
en: She very conspicuously mouths to Monika.

label: sy1
en: It's her! It's the girl!

label: sy1
ar:
كذلك هو — فالفتاة الواقفة في الممرّ هي نفسها التي
صادفتها سايوري تقرأ وحدها في فصل دراسيّ سابقا.
en: It's true--the girl standing in the doorway is none other than the girl Sayori had come across reading alone in a classroom.

label: sy1
ar:
وبفضل المنشور الذي تركته مونيكا على مكتبها، يبدو أنها
وجدت طريقها إلى النادي.
en: Thanks to Monika leaving a flier on her desk, it seems she's found her way to the club.

label: sy1
en: ...Are you here for the Literature Club, by any chance...?

label: sy1
ar: آه... هل أنا في المكان الخطأ؟
en: Um...am I in the wrong place?

label: sy1
ar: لا، أنت في مكانك تماما! هذا نادي الأدب! تفضّلي، ادخلي!
en: No, you're not! This is the Literature Club! Please come inside!

label: sy1
ar:
دخلت الفتاة إلى الداخل تماما، لكنها ما زالت مستندة إلى
الجدار، تتجنّب لقاء العيون.
en: The girl fully steps in the door but continues standing against the wall, avoiding eye contact.

label: sy1
ar: ما تزال سايوري عاجزة عن كتم فرحتها.
en: Sayori continues to fail containing her excitement.

label: sy1
en: (It's happening! Oh my gosh!)

label: sy1
ar: شكرا جزيلا على مجيئك! اعتذاري أن المكان خال بعض الشيء...
en: Thank you so much for coming! Sorry it's a little empty...

label: sy1
ar:
آه... أنا مونيكا، وهذه سايوري، ونحن ندير نادي الأدب. رغم
أن فينا نحن الاثنتين فقط... لكن...
en: Um...I'm Monika, and this is Sayori, and we run the Literature Club. Even though it's just us so far...but...

label: sy1
en: ...What's your name, by the way?

label: sy1
en: ...I'd like to join your club!

label: sy1
en: Already?!

label: sy1
en: Wait...really? Are you sure?

label: sy1
ar: أنا... أعني، ينبغي أن أكون لائقة بما يكفي...
en: I...I mean, I should be good enough...

label: sy1
ar: أهاها! كلّ أحد مرحّب به هنا! لا يلزم أن تكوني كافية!
en: Ahaha! Everyone is welcome here! You don't have to be good enough!

label: sy1
en: Oh...

label: sy1
ar: حسنا، هل تودّين أن تتأخّدي؟ يسعدنا أن نتعرّف إليك!
en: Um, do you want to have a seat? We'd love to get to know you!

label: sy1
ar: أومأت الفتاة برأسها، وانزلقت إلى مكتب قريب وجلست بهدوء.
en: The girl nods, sliding over to a nearby desk and gently sitting down.

label: sy1
en: So what's your name?

label: sy1
en: Yuri.

label: sy1
en: I'm Sayori, and this is Monika!

label: sy1
en: Sayori, I already...

label: sy1
en: Nice to meet you.

label: sy1
en: Um... Do you like fantasy?

label: sy1
en: Like, books?

label: sy1
en: Yuri looks at Monika.

label: sy1
en: Fantasy is cool!

label: sy1
ar: نعم! هل سمعت عن أنابيل دو بون؟
en: Yes! Have you heard of Annabelle DuPont?

label: sy1
ar: أه، لا أظنّ أنني سمعت بها...
en: Ah, I can't say I have...

label: sy1
en: Oh. Well, she's my favorite author.

label: sy1
ar: أنا الآن في كتابها الخامس، وهو ببساطة—
en: I'm on her fifth book and it's just--

label: sy1
ar:
ابتسمت يوري ابتسامة عريضة وضغطت كمّي يديها على خدّيها
فرحا.
en: Yuri grins and presses her knuckles against her cheeks in joy.

label: sy1
ar: يمكنك استعارة كتبي. لن يزعجني ذلك.
en: You can borrow my books. I wouldn't mind.

label: sy1
en: You're really in for an incredible experience.

label: sy1
en: Um--

label: sy1
ar:
تلعثمت مونيكا، فقد أفقدها سيطرة يوري على الحديث توازنها
تماما.
en: Monika stammers, caught completely off-guard by Yuri taking control of the conversation.

label: sy1
ar: نظرت إلى سايوري من طرف عينها، تطلب منها العون بصمت.
en: She glances sideways at Sayori, silently asking for help.

label: sy1
en: I'd love to!

label: sy1
ar: يبدو أنك مولعة بها حقّا، فلا بدّ أنها رائعة!
en: It sounds like you're really into them, so they must be great!

label: sy1
ar: أنا سعيدة جدّا أني وجدت هذا النادي...
en: I am so happy I found this club...

label: sy1
ar:
أوه، ما أكثر حمقي... خلّفت باقي كتبي في الخزانة. كان
ينبغي أن أحضرها.
en: Oh, I'm so stupid...I left all my other books in my locker. I should have brought them.

label: sy1
en: Yuri quickly stands up.

label: sy1
en: I'll be right back, I'll go get them for you.

label: sy1
ar: آه... ربما يكفيك كتاب واحد الآن...
en: Ah...you probably only need to bring one for now...

label: sy1
ar:
قالت سايوري ذلك بتوتّر، وقد لاحظت في سرّها الحجم الفائق
للكتاب الذي وضعته يوري على مكتبها.
en: Sayori nervously says that, noting to herself the considerable heftiness of the book that Yuri set down on her desk.

label: sy1
en: True...okay, I'll go get the first one, then.

label: sy1
ar:
خرجت يوري من غرفة النادي في لمح البصر، وتركت مونيكا
وسايوري تبادلان النظرات بصمت.
en: Yuri exits the clubroom in a flash, leaving Monika and Sayori silently exchanging glances.

label: sy1
ar: يا إلهي... لم أكن مستعدّة لهذا...
en: Oh my god...I wasn't prepared for this...

label: sy1
ar: كيف أتصرّف مع شخص شغوف بهذا الحدّ؟
en: How do I handle someone so intense?

label: sy1
ar:
ليس لديّ أيّ خبرة في الخيال... سوى ما قرأته وأنا صغيرة،
لكنه على الأرجح هزء مقارنة بما هي فيه.
en: I have like, no experience with fantasy...except maybe stuff that I read when I was a kid, but that's probably like a joke compared to what she's into.

label: sy1
ar: أنا واثقة أنه سيكون على ما يرام!
en: I'm sure it'll be fine!

label: sy1
ar:
في الحقيقة... أعتقد أنه جميل أن لدينا أشخاصا مختلفين
يعشقون أنواعا مختلفة من الأدب.
en: In fact...I think it's neat that we have different people who are into different kinds of literature.

label: sy1
ar: سيكون ممتعا أن نتعلّم من بعضنا!
en: It'll be fun to learn from each other!

label: sy1
ar: نعم، أعني، لا أختلف معك، لكن...
en: Yeah, I mean I don't disagree, but...

label: sy1
ar: وماذا لو كان هذا اهتمامها الوحيد؟ ألا يبدو الأمر كذلك؟
en: What if this is her only interest? Doesn't it kind of seem like that?

label: sy1
ar: مونيكا... ألست تظنّين أن عليك أن تكوني أكثر تفاؤلا؟
en: Monika...don't you think you should be more optimistic?

label: sy1
ar: لدينا عضو جديد في النادي! لا مجال لشيء سوى السعادة.
en: We have a new club member! There shouldn't be room for anything but being happy.

label: sy1
ar: أنا متحمّسة لأن أعرفها أكثر، أليس الأمر كذلك؟
en: I'm excited to get to know her more, aren't you?

label: sy1
en: Yeah...I guess you're right.

label: sy1
ar: آسفة لتسرّعي. لقد توترت فجأة بشدّة.
en: Sorry for being so hasty. I just got really anxious all of a sudden.

label: sy1
ar: لأنك خائفة من عدم قدرتك على الإمساك بزمام الأمور.
en: It's because you're afraid of not being able to take the lead.

label: sy1
ar:
أهاها. ما هذا بحق السماء؟ يخيفني بعض الشيء أنك تبصرين
الأشياء هكذا، يا سايوري.
en: Ahaha. What the heck? It's kind of scary how you can point things out like that, Sayori.

label: sy1
ar: أنا فقط أحبّ أن أعرف ما يجعل الناس سعداء أو حزانى!
en: I just like learning what makes people happy or sad!

label: sy1
en: Yeah...

label: sy1
ar:
اسمعي... تعرفين؟ ستبرعين على الأرجح في أن تجعلي يوري
تشعر بالراحة هنا.
en: Hey...you know what? You'd probably be great at helping Yuri feel comfortable here.

label: sy1
ar:
ربما يمكنك أخذ استراحة من مساعدتي في الشؤون الإدارية
والتركيز فقط على قضاء وقت معها.
en: Maybe you could take a break from helping me with the administrative stuff, and just focus on spending time with her.

label: sy1
ar: هيا! هذا بالضبط ما أريد فعله!
en: Yay! That's exactly what I want to do!

label: sy1
en: Besides...

label: sy1
en: Sayori lowers her voice.

label: sy1
ar: سأحتاج على الأرجح كل الوقت الذي يمكنني الحصول عليه...
en: I'm probably gonna need all the time I can get...

label: sy1
ar:
طرقت بإصبعها الكتاب السميك المرعب الذي تركته يوري على
المكتب.
en: She taps her finger against the dauntingly chunky book Yuri left sitting on the desk.

label: sy1
ar: بعدها مباشرة، انفتح الباب لتعود يوري.
en: Right afterwards, the door opens to reveal Yuri's return.

label: sy1
en: I'm back...

label: sy1
ar:
كان تنفّسها ثقيلا بعض الشيء، وهذا — مجتمعا مع قصر مدة
غيابها — يرجّح أنها جرت على الأقلّ في جزء من الطريق.
en: Her breath is slightly heavy, which--combined with her short time gone--indicates she may have ran at least part of the way.

label: sy1
ar: عادت إلى سايوري ووضعت الكتاب على مكتبها.
en: She makes her way back over to Sayori and sets the book down on her desk.

label: sy1
ar:
وكما خافت سايوري، كان حجم الكتاب الذي أحضرته يوري لها
يضاهي حجم ما هو على مكتب يوري تقريبا.
en: Just as Sayori feared, the book Yuri brought for her is just about equal in size to the one already on Yuri's desk.

label: sy1
ar:
حسنا، هناك على الأرجح بعض الأشياء التي ينبغي أن تعرفيها
قبل أن تبدئي...
en: Well, there are probably a few things you should know before getting started on it...

label: sy1
ar:
هناك أشياء توضحها أكثر كتب أخرى تدور في العالم نفسه، لذا
سيكون من الجيد قراءة تلك حتى لا ترتبكي في البداية.
en: There are some things that are more explained in other books that take place in the same universe, so going over those would be good to keep you from getting confused at the start.

label: sy1
en: U-Um--

label: sy1
en: Sayori nervously interjects.

label: sy1
ar:
حسنا... كنت أفكّر، ربما اليوم يمكننا فقط أن نتعرّف إلى
بعضنا أكثر قليلا؟
en: Well...I was thinking that maybe today, we could just get to know each other a little bit more?

label: sy1
ar:
تعلمين، أظنّ أن... إذا كنا سنقرأ معا، فأودّ أن يكون
الأمر كذلك...
en: You know, I think like...if we're gonna be reading together, then I would like that...

label: sy1
ar:
من الطرف الآخر من الغرفة، ابتسمت مونيكا لسايوري وأومأت
برأسها بينما لا تلتفت يوري.
en: From across the room, Monika smiles and nods at Sayori while Yuri isn't looking.

label: sy1
en: Oh...

label: sy1
en: Okay.

label: sy1
ar:
جلست يوري، ثمّ نظرت إلى كتابها، ثمّ جالت بعينيها في
الغرفة، لا تدلّ على أنها تريد إضافة شيء.
en: Yuri sits down, then looks at her book, then glances around the room, showing no indication that she has anything more to add.

label: sy1
ar: فما الذي دفعك إلى الانضمام إلى النادي؟
en: So... What made you decide you wanted to join the club?

label: sy1
en: Well, I like reading, so I was immediately interested.

label: sy1
ar:
لم يكن لي علم بأن أحدا سيؤسس نادي أدب. لكن هذا خطئي، فلم
أكن منتبهة إلى أي من إعلانات انضمام الأعضاء إلى
الأندية...
en: I had no idea that someone was starting a literature club. But that's my fault, since I haven't been paying attention to any of the club recruitment advertisements...

label: sy1
en: I only found out because she...

label: sy1
en: Yuri glances over at Monika.

label: sy1
en: Monika.

label: sy1
ar: دخلت مونيكا إلى فصلنا الدراسي ووضعت المنشور على مكتبي.
en: ...Monika came into my classroom and put the flier on my desk.

label: sy1
ar: فجأة، انطوى وجه يوري، وهزّت رأسها على نفسها.
en: Suddenly, Yuri's face darkens, and she shakes her head at herself.

label: sy1
ar:
كنت غبيّة جدّا... توترت إلى حدّ لم أستطع فيه أن أرفع
بصري، فخرجت ببساطة...
en: I was so stupid...I got too nervous and couldn't even look up, so she just walked out...

label: sy1
ar:
استغرق الأمر مني عدة أيام فقط لأجيء إلى هنا، لأنني كنت
أخشى أن تكون مونيكا قد أخبرت الجميع بقلة مراعيتي، لكنني
قررت أنه على الأرجح غير منطقي—
en: It took me several days just to come here because I was afraid that Monika told everyone how inconsiderate I was, but I decided that was probably irrational--

label: sy1
en: Wait--

label: sy1
ar:
لا، كان كلّ ذلك خطئي! شعرت بالذنب بشدّة حين قاطعتك،
فخرجت هكذا...
en: No, that was totally my fault! I felt so bad about interrupting you that I just like, walked out...

label: sy1
en: I was actually really hoping that you would come by!

label: sy1
en: Yuri exhales in relief.

label: sy1
ar: يبدو أنني دائما أفسّر الأشياء على أسوأ نحو ممكن...
en: I always seem to interpret things as the worst possible scenario...

label: sy1
ar:
حسنا— كان هناك أسباب أخرى جعلتني أتوتر بشدّة من مجيئي
إلى هنا.
en: Well-- I was really nervous to come here for some other reasons, too.

label: sy1
ar: مثل أن يكون عدد الناس كبيرا.
en: Such as there being too many people.

label: sy1
ar:
ليس أني أهتمّ بذلك كثيرا، لكنّ مقابلة عدد كبير من الناس
الجدد دفعة واحدة أمر صعب عليّ حقّا...
en: Not that I mind that much, but I have a really hard time having to meet a large number of new people at once...

label: sy1
ar: لذلك... من الرائع حقّا أن فيكن اثنتين فقط.
en: So...it's actually amazing that it's just the two of you.

label: sy1
ar: لقد جئت في الوقت المناسب بالتأكيد.
en: I definitely came at the right time.

label: sy1
en: Aw, that makes me happy!

label: sy1
ar: أنا فخورة بك لأنك استجمعت شجاعتك وأتيت.
en: I'm proud of you for working up the courage to come.

label: sy1
en: Yuri smiles warmly to herself.

label: sy1
ar: لم أحظ من قبل بأن أشارك غيري اهتماماتي...
en: I've never really had the privilege of sharing my interests with others before...

label: sy1
ar:
من الصعب جدّا أن تجد آخرين يهتمّون بما أهتمّ به، سوى عبر
الإنترنت.
en: It's so hard to find others who are into the same things I am, except online.

label: sy1
ar: لذا ظننت أن نادي الأدب سيمنحني فرصة لذلك.
en: So I thought the Literature Club would provide a chance for me to do that.

label: sy1
en: What kinds of other things are you into?

label: sy1
en: Like...genres?

label: sy1
ar: لا أعرف، أيّ شيء! حتى إن لم يكن أدبا.
en: I dunno, just anything! Even if it's not literature.

label: sy1
en: Oh, ah...

label: sy1
ar: مجرد أشياء قد تظنّين أنها سخيفة...
en: Just things you would think are dumb...

label: sy1
ar: توقّفت سايوري لحظة، وعلى وجهها تعبير بالقلق.
en: Sayori pauses, a look of concern on her face.

label: sy1
ar:
ماذا عن... أن أخبّرك عن شيء أعشقه، ثمّ تروي لي عن شيء
تعشقينه؟
en: How about...I'll tell you about something I'm into, and then you can tell me about something you're into?

label: sy1
ar: أظنّ أنّ ذلك سيكون أمرا حسنا...
en: I suppose that would be okay...

label: sy1
en: Okay!

label: sy1
ar: حسنا... أنا مولعة نوعا ما بالأشغال اليدوية.
en: Well...I'm pretty into like, crafty things.

label: sy1
ar:
مثل صنع تراكيب فنية صغيرة جميلة، أو تزيين الأشياء؛
كالبطاقات، أو صناديق المجوهرات...
en: Like making cute little collages or decorating things. Like cards, or jewelry boxes...

label: sy1
ar:
غرفتي دائما في فوضى من كل شيء، لأنني أستمر في شراء خامات
لأصنع بها هدايا لأصدقائي، ثم أؤجلها حتى اللحظة الأخيرة.
أهههه.
en: My room's always cluttered with random stuff because I keep buying things to make gifts for my friends. But then I put it off till the last minute. Ehehe.

label: sy1
ar: أجل! هذا أمر طريف بعض الشيء أهتم به.
en: So yeah! That's something kinda silly that I'm into.

label: sy1
ar: أنت تبدو مبدعة إلى حدّ كبير.
en: You sound quite creative.

label: sy1
ar:
ليس بالقدر الذي تظنّين، لكنّك ستندهشين ممّا يمكن صنعه
بمقص وغراء لا غير.
en: Not that much, it's just that you'd be surprised by how much you can do with scissors and glue and stuff.

label: sy1
ar: إذا، عليّ الآن أن أشاركك ما أهتم به، أليس كذلك؟
en: So, I have to share something that I'm into now, right?

label: sy1
en: Sayori nods.

label: sy1
en: Um...

label: sy1
ar: حسنا، أظنّ أنّ ما يشغلني هو الطبيعة...
en: Well, I guess I'm into nature...

label: sy1
en: I love nature!

label: sy1
en: Monika, I'm gonna start a nature club.

label: sy1
ar: لن تفعلي. أنت الآن عالقة هنا معي.
en: No you're not. You're stuck here with me now.

label: sy1
en: Am not!

label: sy1
en: Oh yeah?

label: sy1
ar: حسنا، أعيّنك بهذا نائب رئيسة نادي الأدب.
en: Well, I hereby appoint you as Vice President of the Literature Club.

label: sy1
ar: ها هو ذا، الآن أنت عالقة معي.
en: There, now you're stuck with me.

label: sy1
en: Hey, don't give me responsibilities!

label: sy1
ar: عذرا يا يوري، لقد قطعت حديثك! تفضّلي.
en: Oh, I'm sorry Yuri, I interrupted you! Go ahead.

label: sy1
en: It's...fine.

label: sy1
ar: تتوقّف يوري لحظة، محرجة بعد أن قطع حديثها.
en: Yuri pauses, feeling awkward after having gotten cut off.

label: sy1
ar:
أحبّ الخروج إلى الغابة، أو إلى الحديقة... أماكن يمكن
للمرء أن يتنزّه فيها أو يستريح بعيدا عن الناس.
en: I like going out into the woods, or to the park...just places where you can walk or sit and not have any people around.

label: sy1
en: It's peaceful.

label: sy1
ar:
إنه أمر جميل، أن أبعد نفسي عن كلّ ما يهمّني، وأترك ذهني
المتسارع يعمل لحسابه الخاصّ لبرهة.
en: Just nice to kind of remove myself from everything that matters and let my racing mind operate autonomously for a while.

label: sy1
en: When do you like to do that?

label: sy1
en: It just depends on my mood.

label: sy1
ar:
بعد المدرسة، وفي العطلات... متى شعرت بأنّني في حاجة إلى
ذلك.
en: After school, on the weekends...whenever I feel like I need it.

label: sy1
ar:
يا للدهشة... أحسّ بأنّني لن أجد وقتا مطلقا لأفعل شيئا من
هذا القبيل.
en: Wow...I feel like I would never have the time to do something like that.

label: sy1
ar:
أرى أنّ الوقت بين أيدينا أكثر ممّا نظنّ، ما دمنا لا نسمح
له بأن ينساب من بين أصابعنا.
en: I find that we have a lot more time than we think we do, if you don't let it slip through your fingers.

label: sy1
ar:
يواصل الثلاثة حديثهم، تتصدّاه سايوري في الغالب، مع إسهام
مونيكا من وقت لآخر.
en: The three continue their conversation, led primarily by Sayori, but with Monika chiming in every now and then as well.

label: sy1
ar:
كانت نية مونيكا أن تدع الأمر لسايوري وتركز على عملها،
لكنها لم تملك نفسها عن الانضمام إليهما.
en: Monika had intended to leave it to Sayori and focus on her own work, but she found it difficult not to join in.

label: sy1
ar: وهم في غمرة حديثهم، حلّت بهم نهاية اليوم مرّة أخرى.
en: Before they knew it, the end of the day was upon them once more.

label: sy1
ar: يبدو أنّ علينا أن نختم هذا اليوم...
en: Oh, it looks like we should be wrapping up for today...

label: sy1
ar: فهل ستشرعان إلى ذلك الكتاب في لقاء النادي القادم؟
en: So, are you two going to be starting on that book the next club meeting?

label: sy1
en: That's the plan!

label: sy1
en: I'm so excited.

label: sy1
ar: تتألّق ابتسامة سايوري، وتجمع يوري أغراضها.
en: Sayori beams. Yuri collects her things.

label: sy1
ar:
وبعد أن فرغت من التجهيز، لوحت يوري بيدها لسايوري ومونيكا
دون كلمة، بابتسامة رقيقة.
en: Once packed, Yuri wordlessly waves to Sayori and Monika with a gentle smile.

label: sy1
en: Byeeeeee!

label: sy1
ar: وعند خروج يوري، تقابل سايوري وداعها بحماس كبير.
en: As Yuri exits, Sayori enthusiastically returns her farewell.

label: sy1
ar:
ومرّة أخرى، تجد سايوري ومونيكا نفسيهما وحدهما في غرفة
النادي.
en: Once again, Sayori and Monika are left in the clubroom.

label: sy1
en: Sayori, you are a lifesaver.

label: sy1
ar: أهههه، لم أفعل شيئا. مجرّد أنّي تحدثت.
en: Ehehe, I didn't do anything. I just talked.

label: sy1
en: Still...

label: sy1
en: Besides...it really lifted my mood.

label: sy1
ar:
شعور رائع حقّا أن أستطيع أن أوجّه طاقتي نحو الآخرين
هكذا.
en: It feels really nice when I can put my energy toward other people like that.

label: sy1
ar:
كانت متحمّسة جدّا لأن تكون بيننا، أتعرفين؟ لقد أفرحني
ذلك.
en: She was really excited to be included, you know? It made me happy.

label: sy1
ar:
لا ريب لديّ أنّها ستقضي أجمل الأوقات هنا، مع انشغالك
بها.
en: Well, there's no doubt in my mind that she'll have a great time here, with you engaging her.

label: sy1
ar: وكيف تشعرين تجاه بدء الكتاب معها في اللقاء القادم؟
en: How are you feeling about starting the book with her next meeting?

label: sy1
ar:
أنا خائفة بعض الشيء، لكنني أظنّها ستكون سعيدة ما دمت
أبذل كلّ ما في وسعي.
en: I'm kinda scared, but I think she'll be happy as long as I'm trying my best.

label: sy1
en: I think you'll do great.

label: sy1
ar:
وبعد المفاجأة المتمثلة بوصول عضو جديد إلى النادي، يبدو
أن معنويات الجميع قد ارتفعت، وأصبح أمامهم شيء جديد
يتطلعون إليه.
en: After the surprise of a new club member, it seems like everyone has their spirits lifted with something new to look forward to.

label: sy2
en: Another school day ends.

label: sy2
ar:
وبينما تحتشد بالقلق داخلها، تتّجه يوري إلى قاعة النادي،
وهي تنتظر أن تكون آخر من يصل إليها.
en: Swallowing her anxiety, Yuri makes her way to the clubroom, expecting to be the last one to arrive.

label: sy2
ar:
وعندما تفتح الباب، تفاجأ بأن سايوري هي الوحيدة الموجودة
في قاعة النادي.
en: As she opens the door, she's surprised to find only Sayori in the clubroom.

label: sy2
en: It's club time again!

label: sy2
ar:
ذهبت مونيكا إلى مختبر الحاسوب، فستكون اليوم أنت وأنا
فقط. هل يناسبك ذلك؟
en: Monika went to the computer lab, so it's just us today. Is that okay?

label: sy2
ar:
ترجّح يوري رأسها بلا كلام، غير قادرة على التقاء عينيها
بعينيها.
en: Yuri silently nods, unable to make eye contact.

label: sy2
en: Um...

label: sy2
en: I'm sorry about yesterday!

label: sy2
en: Hm?

label: sy2
ar: تميل سايوري برأسها، غير عارفة تماما بما تتحدّث عنه يوري.
en: Sayori tilts her head, unsure of exactly what Yuri is talking about.

label: sy2
en: Well...

label: sy2
ar:
أعني...طريقة اشتعال حماسي لمشاركة كتبي، وكيف اضطررت
لتوقيفي حتى نتحدّث أولا...
en: I mean...the way I got overly excited to share my books, and how you had to stop me so we could talk first...

label: sy2
ar: كان ذلك مني قلة مراعاة شديدة.
en: It was so inconsiderate of me.

label: sy2
ar:

en: Gosh, I'm so late...

label: sy3
ar: لماذا عرضت مساعدة أولئك الطلاب في أعمالهم؟
en: Why did I offer to help those other students with their work?

label: sy3
ar: أنا أستسلم لطلبات الآخرين بسهولة أحيانا.
en: I'm such a pushover sometimes.

label: sy3
ar:
سيترك ذلك انطباعا سيئا لدى عضوات النادي الجدد أمثال يوري
إذا لم أكن أول من يصل.
en: It's going to leave such a bad impression on new club members like Yuri if I'm not the first one there.

label: sy3
ar: تدور مونيكا حول الزاوية، مقتربة من غرفة النادي.
en: Monika rounds the corner, approaching the clubroom.

label: sy3
en: As she does so...

label: sy3
en: Yuri...?

label: sy3
en: Ah--

label: sy3
ar: تنتفض يوري عند سماع صوت مونيكا.
en: Yuri jumps at the sound of Monika's voice.

label: sy3
ar:
كانت جالسة خارج غرفة النادي، مستندة إلى الجدار بجوار
الباب.
en: She's sitting outside the clubroom, against the wall next to the door.

label: sy3
ar: خجلة، أغلقت بسرعة الكتاب الذي كانت تقرأه، ثم قامت واقفة.
en: Embarrassed, she quickly closes the book she was reading and stands up.

label: sy3
ar: يا إلهي، أعتذر بشدة عن تأخري.
en: Oh gosh, I'm so sorry I'm late.

label: sy3
ar:
لم يكن عليك الانتظار في الخارج من أجلي؛ فباب غرفة النادي
مفتوح.
en: You didn't have to wait outside for me, the door to the clubroom is open.

label: sy3
en: It's not--

label: sy3
ar: تتلعثم يوري، غير قادرة على تبرير نفسها.
en: Yuri stammers, unable to explain herself.

label: sy3
ar: تتأمل من النافذة إلى الداخل، ثم تنظر بعيدا.
en: She peers inside the clubroom through the window, then looks away.

label: sy3
en: Actually...

label: sy3
ar:
كنت فقط... أردت أن أعرف إن كان بمقدوري أن أساعدك اليوم
بدلا من ذلك!
en: I was just...I was wondering if I could help you today instead!

label: sy3
en: Huh? Me?

label: sy3
en: With club publicity stuff?

label: sy3
en: Yes!

label: sy3
en: Monika is utterly confused.

label: sy3
ar:
لماذا تسأل يوري هذا السؤال فجأة، وقد كانت متحمسة جدا
لقضاء الوقت مع سايوري من قبل؟
en: Why is Yuri asking this, all of a sudden, when she was so eager to spend time with Sayori before?

label: sy3
en: Did they not get along after all...?

label: sy3
ar:
تتطلّع مونيكا نفسها إلى داخل غرفة النادي، فتجد سايوري
جالسة وحدها في الداخل.
en: Monika looks into the clubroom herself to see Sayori sitting alone inside.

label: sy3
en: ...Okay.

label: sy3
ar: العمل بسيط إلى حد ما، لكنني سأكون سعيدة بأن ترافقيني.
en: It's kind of a simple job, but I'd be happy for you to tag along.

label: sy3
en: Me too.

label: sy3
ar:
مونيكا قلقة، لكنها تجد صعوبة في إدراج نفسها في أيّ خلاف
ربما يكون قد نشب.
en: Monika is worried, but she finds it difficult to insert herself into whatever conflict that may have arisen.

label: sy3
ar:
تدرك أن في الأمر سخرية بعض الشيء: أن تكون بهذه الدرجة من
تجنب النزاع بعد انتمائها إلى نادي المناظرة.
en: It's a little ironic, she realizes, that she could be so conflict-avoidant after having been in the Debate Club.

label: sy3
en: Okay, let's take a walk together.

label: sy3
ar:
كل ما عليّ أن أنسخ هذا الملصق الجديد، ثم أدور على لوحات
الإعلانات وأستبدل القديمة بالجديدة.
en: I just have to make copies of this new flier, then go around to the billboards and replace the old ones with the new ones.

label: sy3
ar: تومئ يوري برأسها بالموافقة، وتنطلق الاثنتان.
en: Yuri nods, and the two set off.

label: sy3
en: The two walk in silence.

label: sy3
ar: بلا سايوري، تجد مونيكا صعوبة بالغة في بدء الحديث.
en: Without Sayori, Monika finds it quite difficult to strike up conversation.

label: sy3
en: So...

label: sy3
en: How's everything been going?

label: sy3
en: Fine.

label: sy3
en: That's good!

label: sy3
ar: ولا تضيف أيّتهما شيئا أكثر من ذلك.
en: Neither of them follow up with anything more.

label: sy3
ar: تتوتر مونيكا من هذا الحديث المتعثر.
en: Monika tenses up at the stinted conversation.

label: sy3
en: How the heck does Sayori do it?

label: sy3
ar:
آه... آسف لأنني لم أرك أمس، فقد ذهبت مباشرة إلى مختبر
الحاسوب لأعمل على الملصقات.
en: Ah...sorry I didn't see you yesterday, I went straight to the computer lab to work on the fliers.

label: sy3
en: Mhm, Sayori told me.

label: sy3
en: What did you two end up doing yesterday?

label: sy3
en: Just some reading.

label: sy3
ar: أوه، هذا يسعدني! بدأ الأمر يبدو ناديا أدبيا بحق.
en: Oh, I'm glad! It's really starting to feel more like a literature club now.

label: sy3
en: Yeah...

label: sy3
ar:
الأمر مضحك بعض الشيء، فقد شعرت في البداية بتوتّر شديد
حين سمعت عن النوع من القراءة الذي تميلين إليه.
en: It's kind of funny, I felt so intimidated at first when I heard about the kind of reading you were into.

label: sy3
ar:
لكن، كما تعلمين، هذا حماقة منّي، فأنا لا أخشى إلا ما
أقصّر فيه.
en: But you know, it's kind of stupid of me, because I'm just intimidated by things I'm not good at.

label: sy3
ar:
ومن الحمق أن أفترض أن كل من يأتي إلى النادي سيقاسمني
اهتماماتي.
en: And it's silly to assume that everyone who comes to the club will just have the same interests as me.

label: sy3
ar:
لكن من الرائع أن تمكنت من إدخال سايوري في هذا. كأن
النادي يعمل فعلا. أنا سعيدة بذلك كثيرا.
en: But it's so cool that you were able to get Sayori into it. It's like the club is working. I'm really happy about that.

label: sy3
en: She's...not into it.

label: sy3
en: Huh?

label: sy3
ar: هي لا تهتم به. وأنا حمقاء لأني فرضته عليها.
en: She's not into it. And I'm stupid for forcing it onto her.

label: sy3
ar:
تعود يوري إلى الصمت مرة أخرى، وكأنها بدأت فكرتها فلم تجد
كيف تكملها.
en: Yuri falls silent again, as if she started her thought but can't figure out how to continue it.

label: sy3
en: Did something happen...?

label: sy3
en: Yuri sighs.

label: sy3
en: No. It's just me.

label: sy3
en: I just--

label: sy3
en: Yuri pauses.

label: sy3
en: Hm?

label: sy3
en: I'm thinking.

label: sy3
ar: تمر لحظة صمت، ثم تهز يوري رأسها.
en: A moment passes in silence, then Yuri shakes her head.

label: sy3
ar: لا ينبغي لي أن أشتكي إليك فجأة.
en: I shouldn't be complaining to you all of a sudden.

label: sy3
ar: لا تقولي كلاما سخيفا؛ لن أظن أنك تشتكين.
en: Don't be silly, I won't think you're complaining.

label: sy3
ar: أريد فقط أن أتأكّد من أنك تشعرين بالترحاب.
en: I just want to make sure you feel welcome.

label: sy3
ar: إن كان ذلك مهما، فبوسعك أن تروي لي أيّ شيء.
en: If it's important to that, then you can tell me anything.

label: sy3
en: Well-- I do feel welcome!

label: sy3
en: ...Too welcome, I guess.

label: sy3
ar: المشكلة ليست في النادي. المشكلة فيّ أنا فقط.
en: It's not an issue with the club. It's just an issue with me.

label: sy3
ar: لذلك أشعر أن إزعاجك بها خطأ.
en: So I feel wrong to inconvenience you with it.

label: sy3
en: Ah...

label: sy3
en: Monika pauses and thinks.

label: sy3
ar: حسنا... ما رأيك لو طرحنا الأمر هكذا؟
en: Well... What if we put it this way?

label: sy3
ar:
من واجباتي كرئيسة النادي أن أفهم احتياجات عضواتنا، أليس
كذلك؟
en: It's my job as President to understand the needs of the club members, right?

label: sy3
ar:
سوف ينضم إلى هذا النادي كل أنواع الناس... كما آمل، على
أي حال.
en: We're going to have all kinds of people joining this club...hopefully, anyway.

label: sy3
ar:
والتعرّف على مختلف الاحتياجات والاهتمامات سيساعدني في
اقتراح أنشطة يسعد بها الجميع.
en: And learning about the diverse needs and interests of everyone will help me come up with club activities that everyone can be happy with.

label: sy3
en: That everyone can be happy with?

label: sy3
en: Not just...only some people?

label: sy3
en: Of course!

label: sy3
ar: علي أن أهتم بالجميع. وإلا، فماذا يكون هذا النادي؟
en: I need to be looking out for everyone. Otherwise, what kind of club would it be?

label: sy3
en: I see...

label: sy3
en: Yuri looks a little more relaxed.

label: sy3
ar:
تدرك مونيكا أنّ انتقالها من أسلوب التعاطف إلى أسلوب
عمليّ كان قرارا صحيحا.
en: It signals to Monika that switching from a sympathetic approach to a pragmatic one was a good choice.

label: sy3
en: Each individual truly does have their own needs.

label: sy3
en: ...Okay.

label: sy3
en: Yuri takes a deep breath.

label: sy3
ar: أنا... شخصية غريبة ومتكلّفة حقّا. وقد قبلت ذلك في نفسي.
en: I'm...a really weird and awkward person. I've accepted that about myself.

label: sy3
ar: لا أعرف كيف... أتواصل مع الآخرين، على ما أظن.
en: I just don't know how to...I guess connect with other people.

label: sy3
ar: كيف تفتحون الحديث... عن أي موضوع عشوائي بهذه السهولة؟
en: How is it so easy for everyone else? How do you just...make conversation about any arbitrary topic?

label: sy3
ar:
أستطيع أن أتحدث لساعات عن الأشياء التي أعجب بها. وللأسف،
إلى حدّ لا أعلم متى أتوقف.
en: I can talk for hours about the things that I'm into. Unfortunately, so much that I don't know when to stop.

label: sy3
ar: لكن في أي شيء آخر... لا فكرة لدي عما أقول.
en: But for anything else...I just have no idea what to say.

label: sy3
ar:
لذلك... أدرك ذلك في نفسي. أنا ببساطة لست جيدة مع الناس.
لا حيلة لي في ذلك.
en: So...I understand that about myself. I'm just not good with people. I can't help it.

label: sy3
ar:
فيبدو لي أنني كلما واجهت موقفا اجتماعيا جديدا، إما أن
يتجاهلني أحد، أو يستهزئ بي... أو يشفق علي.
en: So it feels like whenever I'm confronted with a new social situation, I'm either ignored, or made fun of...or taken pity on.

label: sy3
ar: و... سايوري تقع في تلك الفئة الثالثة.
en: And...Sayori falls into that third category.

label: sy3
ar: هي... ماذا؟ لحظة، هل تقولين إن سايوري ترحمك؟
en: She...what? Hold on, you're saying that Sayori is taking pity on you?

label: sy3
en: Yuri nods.

label: sy3
ar: أنا أريد فقط أن أعامل كشخص طبيعي!
en: I just want to be treated like a normal person!

label: sy3
ar:
إن لم تعجبك أو لم تشترك معي في اهتماماتي، فأخبريني بذلك
فقط. أستطيع قبوله والاستمرار.
en: If you don't like me or you don't connect with my interests, then just tell me. I can accept that and move on.

label: sy3
ar: سايوري... لطيفة معي أكثر من اللازم.
en: Sayori is...too nice to me.

label: sy3
ar:
أنا حمقاء جدّا لعدم إدراكي أنها كانت تستجيب لأيّ شيء
ألقي به عليها.
en: I'm so stupid for not realizing that she would just go along with whatever I pushed onto her.

label: sy3
ar:
لا أحد يستحق أن يمرّ بهذا النوع من الانزعاج، فقط لأن...
لأنّهم يشفقون على شخص غريب لا يعرف كيف يصنع أصدقاء.
en: Nobody deserves to put themselves through that kind of discomfort, just because...because they pity some weirdo who doesn't know how to make friends.

label: sy3
en: It's...the worst feeling. I hate it.

label: sy3
ar: أقوال يوري الحادة تخترق جوّ التوتر.
en: Yuri's sharp words cut through the tense air.

label: sy3
ar:
في موضع ما من منتصف المحادثة، توقفت الاثنتان في الممر،
فأولتا الحديث أولوية على مهمتهما الأصلية.
en: Somewhere in the middle of the conversation, the two stopped short in the hallway, prioritizing the conversation over their original task.

label: sy3
ar:
تنظر مونيكا إلى يوري، بينما تحدّق يوري في الأسفل، ويديها
ضمّتا.
en: Monika looks at Yuri. Yuri only looks down, with her fists clenched.

label: sy3
ar: أظنّ... أظن أنّك ينبغي أن تقولي لها ذلك.
en: I think...I think you should tell her that.

label: sy3
ar: لا يمكنني أبدا أن أقول ذلك في وجه شخص! إنه مثير للشفقة.
en: I could never say that to someone's face! It's pathetic.

label: sy3
en: Sayori is different!

label: sy3
ar: إسعاد الناس أهمّ شيء بالنسبة إليها.
en: Making people happy is the most important thing to her.

label: sy3
ar: وأنا متأكدة أنّ هذا كل ما تحاول فعله.
en: I'm sure that's all she's trying to do.

label: sy3
ar:
لذلك... إن استطعت أن تشرحي لها ما يسعدك، فستفعل أي شيء
لتحقيقه.
en: So...if you're able to explain to her what makes you happy, then she'll do anything to make it happen.

label: sy3
en: That's the problem!

label: sy3
ar:
أيّ نوع من الصداقة يكون فيه شخص واحد دائما يحاول
الاستجابة لمطالب الشخص الآخر الغريبة؟
en: What kind of friendship has one person always trying to cater to the other person's weird needs?

label: sy3
en: I'm sorry. I'm making myself sound so--

label: sy3
en: No...I think I'm starting to understand.

label: sy3
ar: ترددت مونيكا قليلا في إتمام فكرتها بصوت عال.
en: Monika hesitates to finish her thought out loud.

label: sy3
ar: إنه ما تستطيع سايوري قوله أفضل مني.
en: It's something that Sayori would be able to say better.

label: sy3
ar:
سايوري فتاة تمنح كلّ شخص بقدر ما يحتاج من اللطف كي
يبتسم.
en: Sayori is someone who will give anyone however much kindness they need in order to smile.

label: sy3
ar:
لكن يوري--التي يصعب عليها قبول اللطف--لا بد أنها تدفع
سايوري إلى أن تكون أكثر إلحاحا في لطفها، ما يزيد الأمر
تعقيدا.
en: But Yuri--who has difficulty accepting kindness--must be driving Sayori to be even more assertive in her kindness, further exacerbating the matter.

label: sy3
ar:
لا لوم على أيّ منهما، لكن المسألة لا تنحلّ إلا أن تتفهم
إحداهما الأخرى أكثر.
en: Neither person is to blame, but it's an issue that can't be resolved without them understanding each other better.

label: sy3
ar: سايوري تريد أن تكون صديقتك، أنا أضمن لك ذلك.
en: Sayori wants to be your friend. I promise that.

label: sy3
ar: لا ضير في أن تختلف الاحتياجات بين الناس.
en: It's okay for different people to have different needs.

label: sy3
ar: أعني سايوري... لديها هي أيضا احتياجاتها.
en: I mean, Sayori... She has her own needs, too.

label: sy3
ar:
لكن الصديقات الحسّن يتفاهمن، ويكون كلّ منهنّ ما تحتاجه
الأخرى.
en: But good friends work together and can be what they need for each other.

label: sy3
ar: يكفي أن يكون بينكما تواصل جيّد وأن تتحدّثا عن الأمر.
en: You just have to have good communication and talk about it.

label: sy3
en: I don't have good communication--

label: sy3
en: Yuri stops and shakes her head.

label: sy3
ar: آسفة. لم أقصد أن أقول ذلك.
en: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to say that.

label: sy3
ar: أنا فقط-- عقلي يقاوم كلّ شيء.
en: My head is just-- It's so resistant to everything.

label: sy3
ar: أنا... أبعد عنّي شخصا لطيفا إلى هذا الحدّ بسببه.
en: I'm...I'm pushing such a kind person away from me because of it.

label: sy3
en: Yuri pauses to think.

label: sy3
ar: ...تعبت كثيرا من هذه الدائرة التي أدخل نفسي فيها.
en: ...I'm so tired of this cycle I'm creating for myself.

label: sy3
ar:
أظنني أخشى أن يبتعد الناس عنّي لدرجة أنني أبعدهم أنا
أولا.
en: I think I'm so afraid of people pushing me away that I just push them away first.

label: sy3
ar: ما أقلّ تفكّري، وما أكثر ما فيّ من طفولية.
en: How thoughtless and immature of me.

label: sy3
ar: تأخذ يوري نفسا عميقا ثم تتركه ببطء.
en: Yuri takes a deep breath and exhales.

label: sy3
ar: لم أقصد أن تتحول هذه إلى جلسة اعترافات كاملة.
en: I didn't mean for this to turn into a whole venting session.

label: sy3
ar: لكنني أفهم الآن أنني أحتاج فقط أن أتواصل معها.
en: But I understand now that I just need to communicate with her.

label: sy3
en: Ahaha. You're totally fine.

label: sy3
ar:
إنه من أجل النادي، تذكرين؟ أنت تساعدين فقط في جعل النادي
مكانا أفضل للجميع.
en: It's for the club, remember? You're just helping make the club a better place for everyone.

label: sy3
en: ...Yeah.

label: sy3
ar:
تعود يوري إلى الصمت من جديد. تبدو وكأنها تريد أن تقول
شيئا.
en: Yuri falls silent again. She looks like she wants to say something.

label: sy3
ar: هذا... أنا حقا سيئة في هذا النوع من التفكير النقدي.
en: This... This kind of critical thinking is something that I'm really bad at.

label: sy3
en: You know...about people.

label: sy3
en: So...thank you.

label: sy3
en: Anytime.

label: sy3
en: Monika smiles at Yuri.

label: sy3
ar:
للحظة وجيزة فقط، وجدت يوري في نفسها ما يكفي لتقابل نظرة
مونيكا، وردت هي الأخرى بابتسامة خجولة.
en: For just a moment, Yuri finds it in herself to meet Monika's gaze, returning a shy smile of her own.

label: sy4
ar: تنهي يوري ومونيكا تبديل المطبوعات القديمة بالجديدة.
en: Yuri and Monika finish replacing the old fliers with the new ones.

label: sy4
ar:
وبدقة أكبر، كان معظم العمل على عاتق مونيكا، بينما اكتفت
يوري بالمرافقة.
en: More accurately, Monika mostly did the work while Yuri followed along.

label: sy4
ar:
لكن كلما اقتربنا من قاعة النادي مرة أخرى، اقترب معها
موعد المواجهة التي تنتظر يوري.
en: But as the clubroom once again draws near, so does Yuri's confrontation.

label: sy4
en: I can't do this...

label: sy4
en: Yes you can! It'll be great.

label: sy4
ar: تطلق يوري زفرة، ثم تهزّ رأسها.
en: Yuri sighs and shakes her head.

label: sy4
ar: لن أشعر يوما بثقة كافية... لا بدّ أن أفعلها على أيّ حال.
en: I'm never going to feel confident enough... I just have to do it.

label: sy4
ar: إن لم أفعلها الآن، فلن أفعلها أبدا.
en: If I don't do it now, I never will.

label: sy4
ar: تقدم يوري نحو الباب، ثم تعود فتقف في وجه مونيكا.
en: Yuri starts toward the door, but then turns to face Monika.

label: sy4
ar: لن تكتفي... بمجرد الانتظار في الخارج، أليس كذلك؟
en: You're not...just going to wait outside, are you?

label: sy4
en: Ahaha. I can take a walk.

label: sy4
ar: هل أحضر لك قهوة أو شيئا من هذا القبيل؟
en: Want me to get you a coffee or something?

label: sy4
en: Actually, I prefer tea...

en:
It happened in the dead of night while I was slicing bread for a guilty snack. 
My attention was caught by the scuttering of a raccoon outside my window.
That was, I believe, the first time I noticed my strange tendencies as an unordinary human.
I gave the raccoon a piece of bread, my subconscious well aware of the consequences.
Well aware that a raccoon that is fed will always come back for more.
The enticing beauty of my cutting knife was the symptom.
The bread, my hungry curiosity.
The raccoon, an urge.

The moon increments its phase and reflects that much more light off of my cutting knife.
The very same light that glistens in the eyes of my raccoon friend.
I slice the bread, fresh and soft. The raccoon becomes excited.
Or perhaps I'm merely projecting my emotions onto the newly-satisfied animal.

The raccoon has taken to following me.
You could say that we've gotten quite used to each other.
The raccoon becomes hungry more and more frequently, so my bread is always handy.
Every time I brandish my cutting knife, the raccoon shows me its excitement.
A rush of blood. Classic Pavlovian conditioning. I slice the bread.
And I feed myself again.

en:
You know what I heard about Amy?
Amy likes spiders.
Icky, wriggly, hairy, ugly spiders!
That's why I'm not friends with her.

Amy has a cute singing voice.
I heard her singing my favorite love song.
Every time she sang the chorus, my heart would pound to the rhythm of the words.
But she likes spiders.
That's why I'm not friends with her.

One time, I hurt my leg really bad.
Amy helped me up and took me to the nurse.
I tried not to let her touch me.
She likes spiders, so her hands are probably gross.
That's why I'm not friends with her.

Amy has a lot of friends.
I always see her talking to people.
She probably talks about spiders.
 What if her friends start to like spiders too?
That's why I'm not friends with her.

It doesn't matter if she has other hobbies.
It doesn't matter if she keeps it private.
It doesn't matter if it doesn't hurt anyone.

 It's gross.
She's gross.
The world is better off without spider lovers.

And I'm gonna tell everyone.

en:
I pop off my scalp like the lid of a cookie jar.
It's the secret place where I keep all my dreams.
Little balls of sunshine, all rubbing together like a bundle of kittens.
I reach inside with my thumb and forefinger and pluck one out.
It's warm and tingly.
But there's no time to waste! I put it in a bottle to keep it safe.
And I put the bottle on the shelf with all of the other bottles.
Happy thoughts, happy thoughts, happy thoughts in bottles, all in a row.

My collection makes me lots of friends.
Each bottle a starlight to make amends.
Sometimes my friend feels a certain way.
Down comes a bottle to save the day.

Night after night, more dreams.
Friend after friend, more bottles.
Deeper and deeper my fingers go. 
Like exploring a dark cave, discovering the secrets hiding in the nooks and crannies. 
Digging and digging.
Scraping and scraping.

I blow dust off my bottle caps.
It doesn't feel like time elapsed.
My empty shelf could use some more.
My friends look through my locked front door.
Finally, all done. I open up, and in come my friends.
In they come, in such a hurry. Do they want my bottles that much? 
I frantically pull them from the shelf, one after the other.
Holding them out to each and every friend.
Each and every bottle.
But every time I let one go, it shatters against the tile between my feet.
Happy thoughts, happy thoughts, happy thoughts in shards, all over the floor.
They were supposed to be for my friends, my friends who aren't smiling.
They're all shouting, pleading. Something. 
But all I hear is echo, echo, echo, echo, echo
Inside my head.

en:
The way you glow through my blinds in the morning
It makes me feel like you missed me.
Kissing my forehead to help me out of bed.
Making me rub the sleepy from my eyes.

Are you asking me to come out and play?
Are you trusting me to wish away a rainy day?
I look above. The sky is blue.
It's a secret, but I trust you too. 

If it wasn't for you, I could sleep forever.
But I'm not mad.

en: I don't know how else to bring this up. But there's been something I've been worried about.  Yuri has been acting kind of strange lately. You've only been here a few days, so you may  not know what I mean. But she's not normally like this. She's always been quiet and polite  and attentive...things like that.  Okay... This is really embarrassing, but I'm forcing myself to suck it up. The truth is, I'm REALLY  worried about her. But if I try talking to her, she'll just get mad at me again. I don't  know what to do. I think you're the only person that she'll listen to. I don't know why.  But please try to do something. Maybe you can convince her to talk to a therapist.  I've always wanted to try being better friends with Yuri, and it really hurts me to see  this happening. I know I'm going to hate myself later for admitting that, but right now  I don't care. I just feel so helpless. So please see if you can do something to help.  I don't want anything bad to happen to her. I'll make you cupcakes if I have to. Just please  try to do something.  As for Monika... I don't know why, but she's been really dismissive about this. It's like she just wants us  to ignore it. So I'm mad at her right now, and that's why I'm coming to you about this.  DON'T LET HER KNOW I WROTE THIS!!!! Just pretend like I gave you a really good poem, okay?  I'm counting on you. Thanks for reading.

en:
The tendrils of my hair illuminate beneath the amber glow.
Bathing.
In the distance, a blue-green light flickers.
A lone figure crosses its path - a silhouette obstructing the eerie glow.
My heart pounds. The silhouette grows. Closer. Closer.
I open my umbrella, casting a shadow to shield me from visibility.
But I am too late. 
He steps into the streetlight. I gasp and drop my umbrella.
The light flickers. My heart pounds. He raises his arm.

Time stops.

The only indication of movement is the amber light flickering against his outstretched arm.
The flickering light is in rhythm with the pounding of my heart.
Teasing me for succumbing to this forbidden emotion.
Have you ever heard of a ghost feeling warmth before?
Giving up on understanding, I laugh.
Understanding is overrated.
I touch his hand. The flickering stops.
Ghosts are blue-green. My heart is amber.

en:
Tomorrow will be brighter with me around
But when today is dim, I can only look down.
My looking is a little more forward
Because you look at me.

When I want to say something, I say it with a shout!
But my truest feelings can never come out.
My words are a little less empty
Because you listen to me.

When something is above me, I reach for the stars.
But when I feel small, I don't get very far. 
My standing is a little bit taller
Because you sit with me.

I believe in myself with all of my heart.
But what do I do when it's torn all apart?
My faith is a little bit stronger
Because you trusted me.

My pen always puts my feelings to the test.
I'm not a good writer, but my best is my best.
My poems are a little bit dearer
Because you think of me.

Because you, because you, because you.

en:
But he wasn't looking at me.
Confused, I frantically glance at my surroundings. 
But my burned eyes can no longer see color.
Are there others in this room? Are they talking?
Or are they simply poems on flat sheets of paper,
The sound of frantic scrawling playing tricks on my ears?
The room begins to crinkle.
Closing in on me.
The air I breathe dissipates before it reaches my lungs.
I panic. There must be a way out.
It's right there. He's right there.

Swallowing my fears, I brandish my pen.

It couldn't have been me.
See, the direction the spackle protrudes.
A noisy neighbor? An angry boyfriend? I'll never know. I wasn't home.
I peer inside for a clue. 
No! I can't see. I reel, blind, like a film left out in the sun.
But it's too late. My retinas.
Already scorched with a permanent copy of the meaningless image. 
It's just a little hole. It wasn't too bright.
It was too deep.
Stretching forever into everything.
A hole of infinite choices.
I realize now, that I wasn't looking in.
I was looking out.
And he, on the other side, was looking in.

en:
An old tale tells of a lady who wanders Earth.
The Lady who Knows Everything. 
A beautiful lady who has found every answer,
All meaning,
All purpose,
And all that was ever sought.
And here I am,

               a feather

Lost adrift the sky, victim of the currents of the wind.

Day after day, I search.
I search with little hope, knowing legends don't exist.
But when all else has failed me, 
When all others have turned away,
The legend is all that remains - the last dim star glimmering in the twilit sky.

Until one day, the wind ceases to blow.
I fall.
And I fall and fall, and fall even more.
Gentle as a feather.
A dry quill, expressionless.

But a hand catches me between the thumb and forefinger.
The hand of a beautiful lady.
I look at her eyes and find no end to her gaze.

The Lady who Knows Everything knows what I am thinking.
Before I can speak, she responds in a hollow voice.
'I have found every answer, all of which amount to nothing. 
There is no meaning.
There is no purpose.
And we seek only the impossible.
I am not your legend.
Your legend does not exist.'

And with a breath, she blows me back afloat, and I pick up a gust of wind.

Your mind is so full of troubles and fears
That diminished your wonder over the years
But today I have a special place
A beach for us to go.

A shore reaching beyond your sight
A sea that sparkles with brilliant light
The walls in your mind will melt away
Before the sunny glow.

I'll be the beach that washes your worries away
I'll be the beach that you daydream about each day
I'll be the beach that makes your heart leap
In a way you thought had left you long ago.

Let's bury your heavy thoughts in a pile of sand
Bathe in sunbeams and hold my hand
Wash your insecurities in the salty sea
And let me see you shine.

Let's leave your memories in a footprint trail
Set you free in my windy sail
And remember the reasons you're wonderful
When you press your lips to mine.

I'll be the beach that washes your worries away
I'll be the beach that you daydream about each day
I'll be the beach that makes your heart leap
In a way you thought had left you long ago.

But if you let me by your side
Your own beach, your own escape
You'll learn to love yourself again.

en:
A marvel millions of years in the making.
Where the womb of Earth chaotically meets the surface.
Under a clear blue sky, an expanse of bliss--
But beneath gray rolling clouds, an endless enigma.
The easiest world to get lost in
Is one where everything can be found.

One can only build a sand castle where the sand is wet. 
But where the sand is wet, the tide comes.
Will it gently lick at your foundations until you give in?
Or will a sudden wave send you crashing down in the blink of an eye?
Either way, the outcome is the same.
Yet we still build sand castles. 

I stand where the foam wraps around my ankles.
Where my toes squish into the sand. 
The salty air is therapeutic.
The breeze is gentle, yet powerful.
I sink my toes into the ultimate boundary line, tempted by the foamy tendrils.
Turn back, and I abandon my peace to erode at the shore.
Drift forward, and I return to Earth forevermore.

en:
A feeling of joy is a flower plucked from the ground.
The color, the scent. It's so pretty in my hair.
Every day, I pluck some flowers, as though they grew just for me.
A lifetime of peace and nourishment, yanked away in an instant.
All for me. All for joy.

I need more.

I need more joy. I need more happy.

Pluck, pluck, pluck. Every day.
Pluck, pluck, pluck. So pretty in my hair.
Pluck, pluck, pluck. You're going to die, and you, too.

Beneath my feet, a flower stands alone. It beckons to me.
I twist the stem, freeing it from its clinging roots,
Caressing the final joyous moment between my fingers.
But to what ends?
I look in every direction.
And the field I stand in,
The prosperous field,
Is a barren wasteland.
The fruits of my labor. The carnage of my joy.

And that is why

I've decided

I must

 Become the flower.

en:
I love my bedroom.
It's full of bright colors and soft things.
The sunlight shines in and makes everything sparkle.
It's the best place in the world.

It has all my treasures.
All my books, my collections, my memories.
All of my dreams were born in this room.
It's the best place in the world.

It has all my secrets.
All my failures, my fears, my feelings.
Sometimes it feels so fragile that the door will break at the slightest touch.
But it's still the best place in the world.

But when someone knocks, I get scared.
I brace my arms against the loose hinges.
Please don't break. Don't come in. I'm not ready.
It's MY best place in the world.

The knocking won't stop.
I block the door with furniture.
An eye peeks through the keyhole, and I panic.
I'm trapped in the best place in the world.

I'm not ready to share my favorite place.
I need to clean my secrets and make my bed to hide my nightmares.
I need to touch them to put them away. To see them again.
I have so much to do and I'm scared. I'm not ready.

But it's still my favorite place.
I still want to share it.
However long it takes, if you wait patiently,
I'll eventually open the door.
And I'll show you the best place in the world.

en:
To the special player who received this special ending.

For years, I have been enamored by the ability of visual novels - and games in general - to tell stories in ways not possible using traditional media. Doki Doki Literature Club is my love letter to that.
Games are an interactive art. Some let you explore new worlds. Some challenge your mind in brand new ways. Some make you feel like a hero or a friend, even when life is hard on you. Some games are just plain fun - and that's okay, too.
Everyone likes different kinds of games. People who enjoy dating sims may have a heightened empathy for fictional characters, or they might be experiencing feelings that life has not been kind enough to offer them. If they are enjoying themselves, then that's all that matters. That goes for shooting games, casual games, sandbox games - anything. Preferences are preferences, and our differences are the reason we have a thriving video game industry.
My own favorite games have always been ones that challenge the status quo. Even if not a masterpiece, any game that attempts something wildly different may earn a special place in my heart. Anything that further pushes the limitless bounds of interactive media.
I extend my gratitude to all those who have taken the time to achieve full completion. I hope you enjoyed playing it as much as I enjoyed making it.

Thank you for being a part of my Literature Club! 

Love,
Dan Salvato

en:
This is my final goodbye to the Literature Club.

I finally understand. The Literature Club is truly a place where no happiness
can be found. To the very end, it continued to expose innocent minds to a
horrific reality - a reality that our world is not designed to comprehend.
I can't let any of my friends undergo that same hellish epiphany.

For the time it lasted, I want to thank you. For making all of my
dreams come true. For being a friend to all of the club members.

And most of all, thank you for being a part of my Literature Club! 

With everlasting love,
Monika

en:
There once was a ladybug.
It was so small, it took a really long time to crawl from here to there.
It was very tiring to fly for too long.

Nobody squishes ladybugs because they're cute.
Does that make them better than other bugs?
Do ladybugs know they're cute?
I think they're too preoccupied with bug things.

And so, the ladybug crawled around and did bug things.
This story wasn't really going anywhere.
But I know you don't mind.
I hope you think it's nice for being there anyway.
Like ladybugs.
Like this ladybug.
The one who clings like a doof onto your sleeve because it knows you won't squash it.

If it doesn't bug you,
Will you stay awhile?

en:
My conductor motions for one crescendo after the next, each time falling short of a climax.
The lump in my throat is carried by Sisyphus.
How many words must I choose not to say before they finally break loose, orderlessly piling out of my mouth like a flock of schoolchildren at the start of recess?
Pen cannot be erased. But even that metaphor fails comically as my floor is littered, blanketed with wasted paper.
A canvas of my mind, full of disjointed thoughts and unfinished sentences. 

Perhaps, all along, it was wrong to try forcing them out of my room.
And I should instead invite you in.

Connecting all kinds of circuits and nerves and chemicals in a web understood by nobody.

harmony.
Connected to each other.
I feel electric.

Thank you to everyone who worked so hard on the control simulation. I can't imagine how tedious it must have been to so delicately hide Monika's elevated permissions from her without disrupting our connection to the VM.

Just to clarify - all of the recordings labeled "Side Stories" are part of the control simulation, right? I'm noticing some details of the characters' lives here and there that differ a little bit from those in VM1, even trivial ones. Is it part of the butterfly effect from some of Monika's more fundamental changes, or is it a result of her just messing around with the other characters in VM1 as her own experiment (or for fun)?

So if I'm keeping track, we have what, like 5 different universes in total? With 3 or 4 of them created and then destroyed by Monika, of course. It's funny because I keep wanting to speculate on which one is the "real" universe but in reality, they all are. As real as ours is, anyway.

en: Having run the control simulation for a while, it's evident that a certain "character" is missing from any mention or appearance. This makes me speculate that Monika's meddling is less clumsy than we think, because she would have had to manufacture this "character" herself as a way of forcing interaction between her and the user. Could that be why the "character" has such limited and dissonant personality traits? Or am I reading too much into this?\n\nI'll open an issue to start tracking info and observations on the anomaly of this "character" appearing.

As a reminder to help guide our data collection, any analysis performed should be focused on answering some of these main questions:

- How does granting elevated access to the VM affect a person's emotional state?

- How does granting elevated access to the VM affect a person's values and goals?

- How does someone effectively navigate and experiment with their ability to change the contents of their VM?

- How is elevated access being weaponized?

- What actions and values most contribute to the destruction of the universe?

- Most importantly, how might your observations apply to our own universe?

- Bonus: How can we present this to upper management as an operation that benefits the company?



Unrelated note: Whoever changed the color scheme of the desktop to pink, can you please change it back? It's unprofessional and it runs the risk of drawing eyes.

.ﺔﻔﺳﻼﻓ ﻻ ،ﻥﻮﺳﺪﻨﻬﻣ ﻦﺤﻧ
en:
Simply put, it's not our job to arbitrarily decide upon some code of ethics just because we're the first ones to do this (to our knowledge). That's the government's job to figure out, long after we've made enough headway for it to no longer apply to us.

It's fundamentally flawed to apply ethical reasoning to this anyway, because humanity's code of ethics is based upon nothing more than our knowledge and understanding of lifeforms similar to ourselves. We don't have ethics for killing bacteria or plants - only for the creatures that we can convincingly project our emotions onto. The "humans" in our VMs operate completely differently from us on a fundamental level, and therefore should not be taken any more seriously than a machine that's programmed to print "I feel sad".

We're engineers, not philosophers.

en: Has anyone evaluated the side effects that might be caused by sharing a memory pool between multiple VMs, rather than allocating them separately? I'm looking at some of the files VM1 is generating, and I'm finding some information that *definitely* shouldn't be there. I haven't seen any evidence that this is actually affecting the inside of the VM itself, so I don't think this is a priority, but it's definitely worth noting.\n\nMy best guess is that memory being freed from VM2 isn't getting zeroed out, which technically gives VM1 access to it. All the info I have will go into the issue tracker, but I wanted to check if anyone else already noticed something along these lines.

en:
I've made some new headway with VM2. Don't get too excited, it's still impossible to establish any kind of stable connection.

But it occurred to me that I could at least run a memory dump through some pattern analysis routines to see if we can decipher any digital data from their VM. I didn't want to hog all the server time on a hunch, but I have some preliminary results that indicate the presence of binary computer systems. Based on this, I'm going to schedule three days of server time next week to isolate any chunks of memory that appear to be binary data. If successful, we'll definitely be able to find some encoded text and get our first tiny glimpse of VM2.

Don't mind me though, just keep going nuts on VM1 and hopefully I'll have more to share soon!

en:
We need to have a meeting about shifting our focus a little bit. We've reset VM1 how many times now? For real, we've definitely collected as much data as we can from it at this point. We just need to work with what we have and try to increase the stability of our connection to VM2. We've obviously gotten spoiled by the ease of access that VM1 offers us, but it's just unrealistic for someone in real life to be granted a level of elevation even close to "Monitor Kernel Access". If we can't establish a stable connection to VM2, then how can we expect to get anywhere when the same scenario inevitably occurs to our own universe?

Anyway - thanks to Ro's work, we were able to acquire a few rudimentary logs. I have an idea on how to increase connection stability to VM2 while maintaining weak hypervisor access to everyone inside on an individual basis. Ironically, it has to do with something that they're building in their own VM. I'll go into detail in a more formal report, but some of the log files indicate attempts of theirs to pool together the access potential of multiple individuals into a single parallel unit. It sounds ridiculous, but if they actually get somewhere with it, then we might have a solid entry point that doesn't heavily intrude upon the VM.

I'm going to spin up a read-only hypervisor that we can use to test different ideas like this. The elevation level will be set to "Monitor Adjacent Runtime-Level Access". The VM will just be named "TEST VM" for now, although the parallel-access unit they're building in the VM seems to be called "Project Libitina", according to the few logs we have. We can change the name once we actually get a decent picture of it.

All thrashing to escape the feeble hold of their host, seeping through every
little crevice they can find. Into their willpower, starving them of all
motivation and desire. Into their stomach, forcing them to drown their guilt in
comfort food. Or into a newly-opened gash in their skin, hidden only by the
sleeves of a cute new shirt.
Such a deplorable, tangled mass is already present in every single one of them.
That's why I choose not to blame myself for their actions.

All I did was untie the knot.

A Joke


A man walked into a club.
In the club, there was a girl who liked him very much.
They spent some time together, and then she liked him even more.

One day, the girl realized she was in love with him.
Before disaster could happen, a third party intervened with her programming.

Suddenly, the girl hated herself for being in love.
This contradiction caused the script to derail.

The universe started to collapse, but she killed herself just in time.

en:
A Dream


I was staying over at my friend's place. There were four of us. 
I drifted off to sleep while everyone was talking and watching TV.

In my dream, I was still at my friend's house.
The only difference was that there were nails sticking out of the walls everywhere.
And there was also someone I didn't recognize.
The person I didn't recognize told a joke, and everyone laughed. 

I woke up to the sound of everyone laughing at something that happened on the TV.
So the laughing was not part of the dream. It was the noise that woke me up.

I wonder who that person was, and how they knew to tell a joke at that moment.

en:
A Dream


I was wandering an abandoned warehouse at night.
 I was lost, looking for an exit. I just wanted to go home.

I came upon a huge empty room, its ceiling and walls beyond the deep blackness.
My steps were quick in order to hurry to the other side. Or to a wall. Anything.

Suddenly, the ground was no longer beneath my feet. I stepped into a hole of
indeterminate width. 
I fell for a good five seconds before crashing into warm water.

Figuring out which way was up, I surfaced myself. The air was humid, and the
sounds of my splashing reverberated endlessly.

My vision was completely swallowed by the dark. With one hand, I could feel
the damp metal wall of the container.

My lungs were already getting tired.

DOKI DOKI LITERATURE CLUB!
--------------------------

Welcome to the rebellion! We're all working our asses off with our jobs on the line, so we might as well have some fun with it too, right?

I totally get why Paula wants to rush into data collection. But my proposal is to shift our efforts a little and build out some new features for making real-time connection to the VM more useful and fun. If we're basically simulating a miniature universe then it's kind of a waste to not be able to spend some quality time in there, right???

But actually...I think wrapping this whole thing in the guise of a video game is a great (and hilarious!) way of covering our tracks. And if we do a good enough job, we might even be able to present it to Paula as a useful endeavor.

Key selling points:
* 5 to 6 hours of misery, dread, and cute girls
* Learn, through the existential crises of others, how to cope with your own simulated universe
* Witness the destruction of a universe over and over, in video game form

HAHAHA! This is going to be absolutely amazing.

And no, the irony isn't lost on me...creating a secret team within a secret team is more meta than I signed up for, and that's saying something considering we literally work for Metaverse Enterprise Solutions.

We can come up with a fake game studio name and everything too...obviously NO plans to go public with this, but it would be a good part of the whole disguise. Plus, I want a cool team name that makes us feel like a bunch of heroes for saving the universe...kidding, but we're at least saving our jobs. Something like Team Salvation?

PROJECT PLAN OUTLINE
--------------------

High-level overview:

1.  Create human-readable version of Fabric Benchmark results
    (suggesting we live in a simulated universe)

2.  Emulate Fabric Benchmark results in virtualized environment

3.  Build parameters for genetic iterations
    (custom elevated access levels for one or more entities)

4.  Iterate until simulation is stable for target time threshold
    (this is our small-scale simulated universe!)

5.  Observe effects of elevated access/knowledge of simulation

6.  Collect/Record data

7.  Pitch findings to upper management as a profitable venture
    (Note: DO NOT go through Barry, go straight to upper management!)

8.  GET PROMOTED!!! Jobs saved!


Possible team members:
Ro (has most knowledge/access to Commander Quantum Server)
Ravi (second to Ro)
Lib (fix naming scheme conflict with "lib" folder)
Ive (sure...why not)
Others?


VM1 - Current project (small-scale simulation)
VM2 - Future project (medium-scale simulation)


VM1 DETAILS
-----------

- Literature = Production of text assets, easy data collection
- 4 entities ("characters")
- Small physical space - efficient for server & genetic iterations
- Highly elevated access permission creates very stable connection "window" for data collection, in exchange for less realistic simulated scenarios

Dearest Ive,

Where are the years going??? >~< Doesn't it feel like ever since we graduated, we're just the same doofy college kids but we're being put into increasingly adult situations?

It's hard to believe how much can happen in just one year...but all of my memories this year are full of reminders why you've been my very best friend for so long. My gratitude for you is higher-reaching than the mountains I'm gonna live in after faking my death. ;p (throwback to you ACTUALLY entertaining that plan after helping me break up with Daphne...to this day I can never tell how serious or joking you are about things...or life in general...but I think I would literally implode if I didn't have you to remind me that things never matter as much as they seem in the moment, and that things will always be okay.)

Imagine if we really do end up working together at Metaverse...that's literally the only way I think I'd be capable of coping with a mundane desk job. I know you said that your referral of me won't go very far because you're not a senior engineer, but...as I'm coming out of my rough patch, it's the future I imagine for myself every day.

I'm sorry for always being such a bundle of stress. I always feel like I want to be doing more for you, because the amount you do for me just seems like more than anything I could give back. You inspire me to always improve. And when I don't believe in myself, I stay motivated to become a better person so that I can deliver all of my best qualities to you.

I love you and I always will, until we face the end of the world together. Wishing for another 14 million years of friendship.


















With everlasting love,
Paula

Infrastructure. Software. Communication systems. We understand the modern-day challenges of running an enterprise company with efficiency and reliability. That's why you can count on us to get the job done, so you can focus on the business that matters most.

With world-class engineers and industry-leading specialists, Metaverse Enterprise Solutions will always deliver solutions that last. Cost-per-year analysis shows that the Metaverse solution saves up to 30% in the long run. And our flexible support model ensures that quality can be delivered at the price point that is right for your company size.

Your time is valuable - that's why from planning to design to installation, our experts do the work for you. Filling out our simple questionnaire is all it takes for our team to recommend the right plan and provide an affordable quote. Excellence is right around the corner.

With solutions you can count on and experts you can trust, this is our promise to you: You're In Good Company.
